title: Injury-event-level evaluation of machine learning models for athlete injury risk prediction: reproduction package

creators.name: Wang, Jian
creators.affiliation: Department of Physical Education, Jiangsu Vocational College of Medicine

creators.name: Huang, Jie
creators.affiliation: Faculty of Education and Sports Studies, Universiti Malaysia Sabah

description: Code, the two public datasets and the result files that regenerate every table and data figure of the manuscript "Injury-event-level evaluation of machine learning models for athlete injury risk prediction: a benchmark across two cohorts" and of its Supplementary Information. The code is released under the MIT License; the bundled datasets keep their original licences (CC BY 4.0 for SoccerMon, CC0 1.0 for the running cohort).
